title: Saylani TITAN Zamzama Campus, Karachi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Saylani TITAN Zamzama Campus, located in Karachi, Pakistan. Address: 3rd Floor, Plot No. 15-C, 9th Zamzama Ln, Zamzama Commercial Area, Defence V, Karachi, 75600. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Karachi as the city.
